reports.pulse: After Monday's historic +6.5% AI relief rally on Jensen Huang's Nvidia reinstatement, NQ and ES futures are reversing lower pre-market on profit-taking, lingering AI questions, fresh Iran sanctions/Hormuz mine claims, and near-certain December Fed hike pricing ahead of Wednesday's PCE.
reports.bias: mixed — Huang-driven snapback fading into profit-taking and hawkish Fed/Iran headlines; oil soft and Asia chased overnight keep it two-way into thin holiday liquidity
items: @T_LauRekt (~4:22 PM ET Mon): $NQ best day since Apr 2025; Nasdaq Comp +6.47% to 24,081, NDX +6.86%, S&P +4.75%, NVDA +32% to $166 after Huang reinstated; WTI -3.9% to $80.17
@SaloneStephen (~6:59 AM ET): Morning briefing — Mon face-ripper NVDA +31% SPX +4.7%; this morning NQ futures -1.4% ES -0.71%; Dec hike ~94% odds; Iran claims hit three tankers with mines in Hormuz
@rittikd (~6:58 AM ET): Pre-market edition — S&P futures ~-0.6% NQ -1 to -1.3%; NVDA -5% after +31%; Asia Nikkei +3.9% KOSPI +6.3% chasing while BTC gave back to $59k
@NightOwlTrade (~7:00 AM ET): Hormuz risk escalates as IRGC says another tanker hit a mine; AI mixed with Anthropic below IPO; sentiment bearish
Web/Benzinga (~5 AM ET): Dow/S&P/Nasdaq futures fall after Scott Bessent unveils fresh Iran sanctions and Hormuz warnings; NQ ~-1% premarket
reports.trump: Trump backed the Nvidia board's reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO with no national-security risk and has been involved in the rehiring push. On Iran he has paused further strikes until after the new year but leans toward resuming them after Jan 1 if talks stall; new Treasury sanctions announced.
